sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
Mactac is a leading supplier of pressure-sensitive adhesives founded 65 years ago, providing acrylic and rubber adhesive technologies for markets including label printing, graphic design, packaging, automotive, and medical device assembly.

Industry: Adhesives & Materials · Size: $50M-$250M · Products: Prime Label Films, Prime Label Paper, Durable Films, Wide-Format Print Media, Engineered Tapes & Laminates, Medical Tapes

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: Mactac scores 38 of 100 (tier disqualified) at 90% confidence. The score is carried by application fit (16/25), company size (8/15) and pain-point alignment (10/15). Nothing was found for event engagement, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: They already market on uv resistance, lifespan, which means the durability conversation is a product discussion rather than an education. Relevant Tedlar positioning: Tedlar PVF films hold colour and gloss through years of direct UV exposure. Tedlar overlaminates let printers underwrite longer graphic warranties.
